intent.en: Implement a bounded four-joint GPU rigid kinematics helper with independent static native reference evidence. Do not claim full G01, U018 or U062 equivalence.

acceptance: Only GPU computes body/joint/inertial transforms; no CPU fallback or Python in product build/tests/runtime.
Checked qpos batch shape, finite inputs, usable quaternions, canonical world pose and unit model rotations/slide-hinge axes precede device allocation.
Kernel adapter enforces session identity and synchronous completion with owner retention on uncertainty; unsafe ABI/access assumptions remain internal.

Static MuJoCo 3.12.0 native C++ reference fixtures cover four joints, off-center rotations, static ancestors, rotated body/inertial frames and multiple independent worlds under predeclared tolerances.
Run Windows default/CUDA/native/all-feature checks and explicit GPU/native regression tests, preserve existing contracts and keep full product modules planned.
Refresh real source evidence and validate architecture without weakening existing rules.
note:
Linux deferred by user. Native CUDA C++ remains a permitted correctness probe, not a production route. Transfer node now groups two real source leaves (core/kernel); all original public paths remain unchanged and dependencies follow their new owner. Existing acceptance criteria remain unchanged.
Windows MSVC debug/release full feature matrix: 150 host tests plus 6 doc tests each; 54 explicitly enabled regression tests each. New CUDA-only smoke 5 tests, all-feature smoke 6 tests, each profile. All-feature native and restricted smoke 22 each; native-only/restricted 17. Fixed 2e-5 absolute/relative tolerance; maximum measured absolute error 4.5840667395324886e-7 over 1347 checked worlds per all-feature smoke. Four native references regenerate identically. fmt, clippy feature matrix and warning-denied rustdoc pass. Original 183 contracts preserved; transfer core/kernel reflect two real source responsibilities. Only narrow helper leaves active; seven product modules stay planned. Commit 88f82b3, clean post-commit release smoke at target/kinematics-probe/e3030e9dad46474fad00de779ceb8ccb/report.json. Linux, full G01/U018/U062 and production route remain unaccepted.
